```esql
FROM books
| WHERE book_no IN ("7480", "8605")
| DENSE_VECTOR suffix = "_vec" ON title, publisher WITH { "inference_id" : "test_dense_inference" }
| SORT book_no
| KEEP book_no, title_vec, publisher_vec
```
